translations.web: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”
translations.bsb: But some of them asked, “Could not this man who opened the eyes of the blind also have kept Lazarus from dying?”
translations.kjv: And some of them said, Could not this man, which opened the eyes of the blind, have caused that even this man should not have died?
translations.asv: But some of them said, Could not this man, who opened the eyes of him that was blind, have caused that this man also should not die?
